summary: Celaeno is one of the Pleiades, a daughter of Atlas and Pleione. By Poseidon she bore Lycus, whom the god set in the Islands of the Blest. She is distinct from Celaeno the Harpy.
attribution: Adapted from Wikipedia, "Pleiades (Greek mythology)" · CC BY-SA 4.0

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: Apollodorus names Celaeno among the Pleiades and says Poseidon lay with her first among the sisters, begetting Lycus (Bibliotheca 3.10.1).
